name: Rander Corporation Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Rander Corporation 
Ltd provides Financing and Securities Trading, and also operates in the infrastructure segment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RCL is an NBFC, it gives loans to various segments and also makes investments in capital market securities under its NBFC  license. Company also undertakes real estate projects

pros: Stock is trading at 0.67 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 1.64% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 65.8 to 95.9 days.
Working capital days have increased from 2,011 days to 3,583 days
